canonicalOwners.capability: append-only side-effect lifecycle and crash reconciliation
record provider truth after original lease expiry
provider outcome classification and retry gating
provider evidence cryptographic integrity and binding

invariants.statement: An unknown provider outcome cannot authorize retry or commit.
invariants.runtimeBehavior: status=unknown throws PROVIDER_RECONCILIATION_INCONCLUSIVE and leaves reconciliation_required

invariants.statement: Provider application observed after response loss commits historical truth without repeating the original mutation.
invariants.runtimeBehavior: proves historical fence, verifies provider evidence and records observed applied outcome

invariants.statement: A stale worker cannot commit after a newer fencing token exists.
invariants.runtimeBehavior: live commit evaluates current fencing token at explicit recorded time and rejects stale token

invariants.statement: not_applied requires repeated authoritative absence before retry can be prepared.
invariants.runtimeBehavior: one absence remains unknown; only repeated separated absence produces not_applied
invariants.contractScenario: repeatedAbsencePreparesFreshRetry uses pre-qualified durable absence evidence

invariants.statement: Every authorized retry has a strictly newer fence and a rotated provider idempotency key.
invariants.runtimeBehavior: acquires a new monotonic lease and rejects equal/older fence or reused provider key

invariants.statement: An active lease is never stolen implicitly to prepare a retry.
modelGuards: retry planner active-lease rejection targeted scenario
invariants.runtimeBehavior: LEASE_ALREADY_HELD fails closed while an effective lease remains active
invariants.contractScenario: covered by T0502 model targeted scenario and existing lease contracts

invariants.statement: Partial provider application cannot be treated as absence, retry or full commit.
invariants.runtimeBehavior: partial routes to requireCompensation and compensation_required

invariants.statement: Provider evidence used to change durable truth is cryptographically verified and bound to the exact original operation attempt.
invariants.contractScenario: T0501 PR #64 exact-source evidence; T0502F applied scenario consumes ProviderReconciler

invariants.statement: Reconciliation observations are read-only and do not themselves repeat the provider mutation.
invariants.runtimeBehavior: GET-only pinned transport; inspectors/clients expose no write method
invariants.contractScenario: applied scenario asserts read-only inspection; T0502E semantic harness
